status_reasoning: testdata/evaluation/v1/tasks.json and docs/fullstack-acceptance.md section 5 both say this task's expected packet status is 'empty'. That is NOT what internal/contextpacket/packet_state.go's setStatus() actually produces given the real dev-health-source-catalog.v1 (17 sources): with branch=release/1.4-unindexed, every one of the 5 EvidenceScopeBranch queries runs and returns zero rows ('no_evidence' -- this holds regardless of the 10 background-density rows added for task-001, since none of them are on this branch), the 10 EvidenceScopeRepo queries are skipped ('repo_fallback_branch_not_supported'), and the 2 EvidenceScopeCommit queries are skipped ('commit_scope_not_requested') -- all 17 sources end up in bundle.Unavailable, unconditionally, for this scope shape, independent of the incidents.v1 product bug (task-001's oracle) and independent of how rich the rest of the fixture is. setStatus()'s branch for len(packet.Items)==0 is: 'if candidateCount>0 -> Partial; else if len(bundle.Unavailable)>0 -> Degraded; else -> Empty, warn no_evidence_found'. Because Unavailable is non-empty here, the Degraded branch fires, not the Empty branch. PacketEmpty and the literal 'no_evidence_found' warning are UNREACHABLE for this task by any fixture: they require bundle.Unavailable to be empty, which is impossible once even one branch-scoped source returns zero rows for a branch nothing was ever seeded on -- true no matter how many other sources are populated elsewhere. This is a genuine mismatch between the design doc / evaluation corpus and the real code -- flagged prominently in the delivery report for the doc owner / packet_state.go owner to reconcile (either relax setStatus's Empty/Degraded split, or update the doc's expected statuses). Unlike task-001, there is no future code fix that flips this task to 'empty' -- it is a permanent property of an intentionally-populated fixture being probed on a branch with zero rows, so this status_reasoning does not need revisiting when incidents.v1 is fixed.
expected_unavailable_sources_note: All 17 of 17 catalog sources, by construction: 5 branch-scoped sources genuinely queried and genuinely empty for this branch ('no_evidence'), 10 repo-scoped sources skipped outright because branch is set, 2 commit-scoped sources skipped outright because commit_sha is empty. incidents.v1 appears here for the repo_fallback_branch_not_supported reason (same as the other 9 repo-scoped sources), not because of its own product bug -- fixing incidents.v1 will not change this list. Same goes for the second, independent bug, CHAOS-3069, described in task-001's oracle (source_executor.go's scanEvidenceRow can't scan the native Float32 confidence column of work_graph.v1/ai_workflow_artifacts.v1/ai_review_outcomes.v1/deployment_incident_provenance.v1): it can only fire once a query executes, and all four are skipped here for scope reasons before that happens. Fixing CHAOS-3068 or CHAOS-3069 (independently or together) leaves this task's 17-entry list unchanged.
